Treatment summary
Patient prseented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, restricted cervical range
of motion, and muscle spasm. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the impact, and the
presenting symptoms align well with a cervcial strain. Over the course of fourteen visits, care progressed along a
typical conservative pathway that included manual therapy, guided home exercise, and anti-inflammatory medication.
Symptoms and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced in step with recovery. Imaging
and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical
region is known to this provider. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated
charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
